remarks: Welcome to the magnificent 114 Ledgebrook Drive. This spacious 2,050 square foot townhouse offers two levels of luxurious living space with an extraordinary layout. One of the largest units in the complex. Boasting high ceilings throughout, the home features 3 generously sized bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and 3 cozy fireplaces. The newly renovated interior includes a kitchen with stunning quartz countertops and an eat-in area with a pantry. The primary bedroom is a sanctuary with a relaxing Jacuzzi in the primary bath. The townhouse also offers a versatile loft area, perfect for an office. Hardwood floors and central air conditioning provide comfort and style. The family room, with its own fireplace, can be easily converted into a 4th bedroom, adding flexibility to the home. Additional features include a garage and extra parking space behind the townhouse. Residents enjoy access to a clubhouse, swimming pool, baby pool, sauna, hot tub, gym, and beautifully landscaped grounds. This townhouse is a must-see, conveniently located near I-95, shopping, and restaurants. Don't miss the chance to make 114 Ledgebrook Drive your new home. Home sweet home! This is a short sale. Professional photos to follow
